These short 440 Hz tones were generated by a synthetic Web Audio oscillator and recorded by real Chromium and WebKit MediaRecorder instances for private media regression tests. They contain no microphone input or user content.

- `voice-chromium.webm`: Chromium Opus/WebM with no container duration, reproducing older stored voice messages.
- `voice-webkit.m4a`: WebKit AAC/MP4 finalized with FFmpeg, matching the seekable format served to clients.
